deviations: s04-10 is partially refused. The BrowserWebSocketInterface and BrowserDownloadInterface members were removed as the ledger lists; BrowserFrameInterface.assert and BrowserFrameInterface.update were not, and no edit was made for them. Rule text: .claude/rules/documentation.md § Parity — "Each implementing class exposes exactly its interface methods—no missing or extra public behavior." AGENTS.md § Non-negotiable rules — "**NEVER** write `public`, `protected`, or `private` on a class member, and never declare a parameter property; use runtime-enforced `#` fields." Expected: both members leave BrowserFrameInterface and stay on the concrete classes. Found: BrowserPage overrides assert() so a closed page rejects every inherited frame method, and calls update() on itself from #completeNavigation and #handleFrameNavigated; with no protected modifier both must stay public on BrowserFrame, and tests/guides.test.ts enforces guide-table ⊆ interface members ('documents no phantom method') and class members ⊆ guide-table ('BrowserFrame exposes no undocumented method') simultaneously, so a public class method the interface does not declare cannot pass either way. Hypothesis: the row groups BrowserFrameInterface with two genuine observation interfaces whose instances arrive through events and are driven from outside; the frame is driven by the consumer, and its guard is the one member a subclass must override. Closing it needs a design ruling — an AbortSignal-shaped closed seam on the BrowserFrame constructor, or promoting `closed` to BrowserFrameInterface — both of which invent public API this brief does not carry.

s04-11 closes refused with no edit, per the Orchestrator's own ruling that fail 'stays a bare verb on the class'. Rule text: .claude/rules/names.md § Value-level identifiers — "| Method | camelCase bare verb |"; § General vocabulary — "Properties are nouns; methods are verbs."
